get.summary: One stream's events from one sequence number, a page at a time
get.description: The events of one stream whose sequence number is at least `fromSequence`, in log order: at most `x-semiont-limits.maxEvents` of them, with the sequence number of the stream's last event. A reader that wants every event from there asks again from the sequence after the last one it was given, until it has the last. A stream is a resource's, or `__system__`, the knowledge base's own. The one read of the event log by position this surface serves: the gateway reads it to replay a scope a subscriber resumes, and a service that follows the record reads it to take what its stream did not deliver.

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: The resource whose stream is read, or `__system__` for the knowledge base's own; percent-encoded.

parameters.name: fromSequence
parameters.description: The first sequence number wanted, inclusive.

200.description: The events, possibly none, and the stream's last sequence number.

400.description: No resource, or `fromSequence` is not an integer of at least 1.

500.description: The stream could not be read.
